notes:
ソファ is a loanword from English 'sofa' referring to a Western-style upholstered couch.

VARIANT SPELLING:
Also written as ⟦ソファー→ソファー：05607_sofaa⟧ with a long vowel. Both are widely used.

TYPES:
- ⟦{二人掛|ふたりが}け→二人掛け：noentry⟧ソファ (two-seater sofa)
- ⟦{三人掛|さんにんが}け→三人掛け：noentry⟧ソファ (three-seater sofa)
- ⟦カウチソファ→カウチソファ：noentry⟧ (sectional sofa with chaise)
- ⟦ソファベッド→ソファベッド：noentry⟧ (sofa bed)
- ⟦{革|かわ}→革：19310_kawa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ソファ (leather sofa)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ソファ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}る→座る：00757_suwaru⟧ (sit on the sofa)
- ソファ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{横|よこ}→横：02984_yoko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (lie down on the sofa)
- ソファ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦くつろぐ→くつろぐ：02576_kutsurogu⟧ (relax on the sofa)
- ソファ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}→座る：00757_suwaru⟧り⟦{心地|ごこち}→心地：noentry⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ (the sofa is comfortable)

COMMON PATTERNS:
Typically takes ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ for sitting/lying on it, and ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ for doing something while on it.
